title: Validation scan of the Osiris shaft

tellings.quote: We have measured also the the Osiris shaft Mm hm. which is well known as a structure.

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who says he scanned beneath the Giza pyramids, tells Michels that his team also measured the Osiris shaft, a deep underground shaft at Giza that is already well known as a structure. He offers it as a check on his method: if the scan shows a known structure correctly, his findings about what lies under the pyramids are easier to trust.
